causes.content:
# The reason behind my every success, big or small, is the Bhagavad Gita.

Ever since I started reading the Bhagavad Gita, I have found:
- Clarity - a sense of the bigger picture, simplified decision-making
- Deep Self-Understanding - the intricate workings of the mind, the whys and hows
- Purpose, meaning in life and heightened attentiveness
- Peace amidst chaos
- Lasting Solace

### *Aren’t you too searching that in your life?*

projects.title: My Projects
projects.rsyatra-desc: A spiritual community platform for member database management and retreat registration. Features include authentication, email verification, password recovery, and profile management. Payment gateway integration and more features planned for next iteration in March 2026.
projects.autoposts-ai-desc: An AI powered tool for generating and scheduling social media posts. Features include user authentication and viewing generated post. Post scheduling feature is planned. Project currently on hold due to other commitments.
projects.burger-builder-desc: A burger customization and ordering web-app. Features include ingredient-based customization, order placement, user authentication, and access to order history.
projects.vidly-desc: Video rental APIs built with Node.js, Express, and MongoDB, free to integrate with your app, just clone and host it! Features user authentication, genres, movies & customer listings, video rental and returns processing.
projects.soulflix-desc: Soulflix is a clone video streaming app with a curated selection of spiritual movies, series, and podcasts. Designed to emulate the best features of popular video streaming apps, Soulflix offers a distraction-free environment to nourish your soul.
